description: Quote, chart, fundamentals, news, analyst, holder, option, fund, filing, search, screener, trending and market-summary data from Yahoo Finance. No account, API key or proxy setup is required.

concurrency.description: Number of tickers fetched in parallel (mode=tickers).
concurrency.title: Concurrency

endDate.description: Latest date for historical bars (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Overrides `range` (mode=tickers).
endDate.title: History end date

includeDividends.description: Include the full dividend history from Yahoo chart events.
includeDividends.title: Include dividends

includeEarningsCalendar.description: Include upcoming earnings dates, estimates and dividend dates.
includeEarningsCalendar.title: Include earnings calendar

includeEarningsEstimates.description: Include EPS and revenue estimates plus growth estimates.
includeEarningsEstimates.title: Include earnings estimates

includeEarningsHistory.description: Include recent quarters with EPS actual, estimate, difference and surprise.
includeEarningsHistory.title: Include earnings history

includeFinancials.description: Include annual income statement, balance sheet and cash-flow statement.
includeFinancials.title: Include annual financials

includeFundData.description: Include fund profile, top holdings and performance for ETFs and mutual funds.
includeFundData.title: Include fund data

includeHistory.description: Include historical bars with adjusted close.
includeHistory.title: Include OHLCV history

includeHolders.description: Include institutional, mutual-fund, major-holder and insider-holder summaries.
includeHolders.title: Include holders

includeInsiders.description: Include insider transactions, insider holders and net share-purchase activity.
includeInsiders.title: Include insider activity

includeInsights.description: Include technical outlook, research reports and significant developments.
includeInsights.title: Include analyst insights

includeOptions.description: Include option chains for optionable symbols.
includeOptions.title: Include options chain

includePrePost.description: Include extended-hours bars for intraday history.
includePrePost.title: Include pre/post market bars

includeQuarterlyFinancials.description: Add quarterly statements under `financials.quarterly`. Takes effect only when `includeFinancials` is also on.
includeQuarterlyFinancials.title: Include quarterly financials

includeRecommendations.description: Include the analyst recommendation summary and four-period recommendation trend.
includeRecommendations.title: Include recommendations

includeSecFilings.description: Include recent SEC filings with EDGAR links and exhibits.
includeSecFilings.title: Include SEC filings

includeSplits.description: Include stock-split history with numerator and denominator.
includeSplits.title: Include splits

includeUpgradesDowngrades.description: Include the latest analyst rating changes.
includeUpgradesDowngrades.title: Include upgrades and downgrades

interval.description: Candle interval. Intraday intervals have shorter Yahoo range limits; incompatible combinations are clamped and reported in the run status.
interval.title: Chart interval

language.description: Language used for names, news and localized labels.
language.title: Language

maxNews.description: Maximum news items per ticker. Yahoo's news graph serves 200+ items through cursor pagination; the actor caps this request at 200.
maxNews.title: Max news items

maxOptionContracts.description: Maximum calls and maximum puts per expiration.
maxOptionContracts.title: Max contracts per side

maxResults.description: Maximum records for screener, customScreener, trending and marketSummary modes. Search uses maxSearchResults.
maxResults.title: Max results

maxSearchResults.description: Maximum number of search results to return (mode=search).
maxSearchResults.title: Max search results

maxStrike.description: Drop option contracts above this strike.
maxStrike.title: Maximum strike

minImpliedVolatilityPercent.description: Drop contracts below this implied volatility in percent, e.g. 25 means 25%.
minImpliedVolatilityPercent.title: Minimum implied volatility (%)

minOpenInterest.description: Drop option contracts below this open interest. Contracts with no open interest are excluded when this is set.
minOpenInterest.title: Minimum open interest

minStrike.description: Drop option contracts below this strike.
minStrike.title: Minimum strike

minVolume.description: Drop option contracts below this volume. Contracts with no volume are excluded when this is set.
minVolume.title: Minimum option volume

optionExpirations.description: How many upcoming option expirations to fetch (mode=tickers, includeOptions=true).
optionExpirations.title: Option expirations

range.description: History range used when no start/end dates are supplied (mode=tickers).
range.title: Chart range

region.description: Yahoo market region used for quotes, search, trending, localization and mode=customScreener.
region.title: Region

screenerId.description: Yahoo predefined screener to run (mode=screener). Predefined screeners are US-centric; use mode=customScreener for a region-aware list.
screenerId.title: Screener

searchQuery.description: Company, fund, index, currency or crypto name to search for (mode=search).
searchQuery.title: Search query

startDate.description: Earliest date for historical bars (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Overrides `range` (mode=tickers).
startDate.title: History start date

tickers.description: Symbols or Yahoo Finance quote URLs (mode=tickers). Examples: `AAPL`, `BRK.B`, `^GSPC`, `EURUSD=X`, `BTC-USD`, `7203.T`, `https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/`.
tickers.title: Tickers

title: Yahoo Finance Scraper Input
